name: 皇家狮鹫
habitat: 天空城（捕捉小狮鹫起养成）
habitatEn: Sky City (catch the cub and raise it)
evolution: 小狮鹫 → 神圣狮鹫（Lv32）→ 皇家狮鹫（Lv46）
evolutionEn: Griffin Cub → Sacred Griffin (Lv32) → Royal Griffin (Lv46)
description: 翼系人气精灵，物攻与速度出色。被动「乘风连击」使用翼系技能后连击数 +1，配合羽化加速先手压制，PVE 收割与 PVP 速攻都有出场空间；页游时代的情怀坐骑之王，如今仍是队伍里的高速物攻手。
descriptionEn: A popular Flying-type Jinie with strong ATK and SPD. Its "Wind Combo" passive grants +1 combo after each Flying skill, and Wing Dash secures the first move — solid in both PVE finishing and PVP rush teams. The page-game era's iconic mount king remains a fast physical attacker.

skills.name: 啄击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 羽化加速
skills.description: 提升自身速度，抢占先手。
skills.descriptionEn: Raises SPD to seize the initiative.

skills.name: 乘风连击
skills.description: 核心被动：使用翼系技能后获得连击数 +1。
skills.descriptionEn: Core passive: +1 combo after each Flying skill.

skills.name: 风之打击
skills.description: 对翼系目标造成加倍伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals double damage to Flying targets.

skills.name: 光之矛
skills.description: 凝聚光之力对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Condensed light deals magic damage to the enemy.
